hook.name: Hook
hook.job: Make you stay. Show an AI result that is almost right.

problem.name: Problem
problem.job: Name the pain you feel today: the screenshot, save, drag, explain loop.

turn.name: Turn
turn.job: Say the product name. The sketch world changes to the Nextshot look.

how.name: How
how.job: Teach the first capture: shortcut, select, circle, answer.

session.name: Session
session.job: The key idea: many screens and many kinds of marks go into one session.

handoff.name: Hand-off
handoff.job: The payoff: one copy and one paste give your agent everything.

close.name: Close
close.job: Show the fixed result, then tell you what to do next.

a.see: A marker-drawn robot labeled "your AI agent" unveils a hand-drawn lemonade stand page. The page has three mistakes: the sign says "Lemonaid", the price is "$9 a cup", and the Buy button is tiny. A stick figure labeled "you" draws in on the right.

b.see: The figure squints. A big question mark pops over its head, and the figure wobbles.

c1.see: The robot leaves and the page shrinks to the left. A white flash, then a screenshot thumbnail appears, named "Screenshot 2026-10-22 at 4.12.07 PM.png".

c2.see: The thumbnail turns into a PNG file icon. An empty "agent chat" box draws in.

c3.see: The PNG file slides down into the chat box.

d.see: Three messy lines type into the chat: "the yellow button. no, the OTHER one.", "left of that. smaller. no, the", "one under the lemon..."

e.see: A tally of ten marks draws in, six more PNG files pile up, and sweat drops appear on the figure.

f.see: The Nextshot icon spins in. A teal circle grows from the center and turns the screen into the dark Nextshot look. The word "Nextshot" rises in.

g.see: The menu bar slides in at the top, and the lemonade page appears as a clean web page. Option, Shift, and F keycaps press one by one. A crosshair drags a selection over the page, and a white flash marks the capture.

h.see: A C keycap shows, and red numbered badges 1, 2, 3 pop onto the sign, the price, and the Buy button. A Command+S keycap shows. The note panel slides in with "Circle 1 (1 of 3): what should change?" and a zoomed preview. "Spell it Lemonade." types in while a mic icon pulses. The menu bar shows "Nshot (1)". Then "Circle 2 (2 of 3)" and "Make it $3."

i.see: The first capture shrinks into a "Session: feedback" tray on the left. A Checkout page and a Flavors page appear, and each flashes white as it is captured.

j.see: Marks land on the new pages: a circle on "Cash only", a box around the Total, an arrow at the "Coming soon" slot, and a general note, "Keep the fonts." Both pages drop into the tray. The menu bar counts up to "Nshot (3)". The tray slides to the center, and a zoom lens shows "Nshot (3)".

l.see: A cursor opens the Nshot menu and clicks "Copy Session Prompt". The menu closes. A hand-lettered mint note says "3 captures. 6 items. One prompt."

m.see: An agent window rises with one pasted message: <feedback_bundle captures="3" items="6">, the Goal line, three thumbnails, and the six items grouped by page. Chips light up in turn: Claude Code, Codex, Any agent.

n.see: Back to the sketch. The stand is fixed: "Lemonade", "$3 a cup", a big Buy button, and a teal underline. The robot and a smiling figure with a cup draw in, with teal stars. The Nextshot icon and name pop in on the right.

o.see: The end card fills in: "Mark it up. Hand it off." with a teal underline, Option Shift F keycaps with "starts a capture", "Get the DMG in this message.", and "Feedback stays on your Mac until you paste it." It holds in silence to the end.

cues.wipe: Teal wipe to the Nextshot look
cues.fix: Back to the sketch, stand fixed

music: A plucked-string loop of four chords (C, G, A minor, F). It gets busier at "Meet Nextshot". It drops to about half volume while the voice speaks. One long chord rings out under the end card.
